usedFor: Worksection holds your projects and Documint builds documents, so “Task Completed in Project” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Completed in Project” in Worksection, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A finished task fills a document template, so reports are built as work closes.

watchOut: “Task Completed in Project” in Worksection is polling and covers a recent time period, so documents follow a scheduled check.
